pr_title: Fix tournament beatmap backgrounds occasionally not loading
pr_body:
I don't even know which component should take blame here, or whether any framework changes should be required to resolve this.

Basically, when constructing a `DelayedLoadWrapper` with a `Func<Drawable>`, a different initialisation path is invoked which doesn't copy sizing attributes from the future drawable (to avoid constructing the drawable until required). At first I thought `ModelBackedDrawable` was at fault, but it was working fine in the framework implementation. Turns out it was an oversight in the local override.

The end result is that the `DelayedLoadWrapper` was of size `(0,0)` and placed in the bottom-left corner of the window, ready to floating-point-precifaaaaaaaaill itself to never load.

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/26550#issuecomment-1893506530

---

This also shows an empty beatmap instead of nothing when no beatmap is selected.
pr_comments: Is there a convenient way to test this?

> I don't even know which component should take blame here, or whether any framework changes should be required to resolve this.

Re: this, if I'm understanding the issue correctly here, the problem is that in the async path, once the drawable is constructed and added to hierarchy, the sizing logic in `DelayedLoadWrapper.Content` would not run? If that is the case, then I'd say that is something that we should probably be looking to fix in framework (that logic should also run on load completion of the content).
Yeah that works too, but i'd rather retain what the underlying implementation does for now.

issue_context.title: Tournament client doesn't always fetch beatmap backgrounds
issue_context.body:
### Type

Cosmetic

### Bug description

Referencing #24993 because it was never actually fixed, or so it seems.

Basically, maps' backgrounds seem not to be fetched correctly in tourney client, leading to a plain dark image instead of the actual map background. Every stat on the map seems to be picked up and being correctly shown except for backgrounds. 

For me it worked until reinstalling windows and reinstalling lazer (having copied and pasted lazer data folder) but it generally _seems_ to happen on every new install of lazer.

I tried deleting cache, as some people previously suggested in a discord server dedicated to tournaments, to no avail.

### Screenshots or videos

![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/52723130/2d663a53-1bd9-4b1e-a174-dec4fd3f8cb1)
![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/52723130/f1f60a34-be34-4833-ae73-a9fb39edc0c9)


### Version

2024.114.0

### Logs

[compressed-logs.zip](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/13943025/compressed-logs.zip)
comments:
The weird part is, this has never happened to us on world cup streams, and I can't repro locally.

---

Your log files are full of initialisation errors from rulesets that can't load. I'm not sure this is related, but I'd ask that you remove those as a starting point (Karaoke / Gamebosu / Yoso).

Also I'm not really seeing any tournament usage in the log files. Did you export the logs just after reproducing the issue, or should I be looking further back in log history?

I do believe rulesets errors don't interfere with this as I already had those rulesets erroring out in startup a few months ago when it still worked as intended, however I'll try and remove them momentarily and send logs once again.

Addressing that, as I could not find any way to export logs from the tournament client I closed it and open regular lazer then export. I think it should be there tho I'll remove all extra rulesets and try to reproduce the bug again.

After removing the rulesets (no more error notifications when opening normal lazer) the same still occurs. As mentioned in #24993, mappool tab loads just fine but it's both gameplay and showcase which show this anomaly. I guess it's the same fetch method for the last two and different for mappool tab?
![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/52723130/3b5c851b-b581-4c80-9e41-1d65de922550)
![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/52723130/421c49b4-359b-4860-a20e-7e42607fde01)
[compressed-logs.zip](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/13948124/compressed-logs.zip)
Does resizing the window randomly help at all?

That's weird... It just worked on gameplay, then showcase still showed dark bg, changed beatmap, then dark again on both, went on showcase resized like crazy a few times and it now seems to pick up every map in both tabs

EDIT: more logs
[compressed-logs.zip](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/13948423/compressed-logs.zip)

So resizing does fix? There's a potential issue with things not loading due to floating point precision and masking if so.

It would be helpful to confirm that in a broken state, if doing nothing but resizing the window (not changing screens) fixes the issue or not.

It seems to do the trick, and it also seems like some resolutions cause this more often, for example, setting height to 800 seems to break the bg consistently as shown in this video:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/52723130/e58c22d8-8e1f-4775-b53c-bc48b01cd97d

review_comments: Is there any significance to this change?
Just felt it was weird to display nothing (like the bar disappears) when no beatmap loaded.

Well sure but it also means that if the local cutting edge instance is opened and you select a _non-online_ beatmap it'll also show that placeholder.

![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/20418176/2f42b30e-3f6d-4cf6-9db1-e79e2f90e74e)

For a client that is to be used for broadcast purposes I feel like showing nothing is better than showing that.

mmm, i'm willing to go out on a limb on this one and revert if requested by tournament hosts.

but can also revert if you think it's best. just weird when testing the tournament client and a whole element is just missing.
